payload.name: Muffed
payload.description: 查询经核实的 NFL 统计数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Muffed answers NFL questions with figures that have already been checked. Every number comes from a gated panel built on nflverse play-by-play, NFL Next Gen Stats and FTN charting data, and every response carries its own source, the date it was verified, and the attribution the data licence requires.

Ask what the data says is actually real in the NFL right now, look up a player's or team's season figures, pull a leaderboard, get a plain explanation of an advanced metric like EPA or CPOE, compare two players side by side, or check a statistic you saw somewhere else — Muffed will tell you the real value when it disagrees. You can also connect a Sleeper league by id to get verified context on the players in it.

Muffed publishes no projections, no start/sit or lineup advice, no draft grades, no rankings-as-advice and no picks, and carries no betting lines or odds. No tool on this server can produce one: there is no projection model behind it and no ranking-as-advice surface.

Every response marks its own boundary. A citation names exactly which figures it covers and states that it does not extend to analysis derived from them. Figures computed on request rather than drawn from the pre-verified panel are labelled `computed_not_verified` and carry the executed method and population size. Where Muffed holds nothing for a request, it says so explicitly, states the coverage it does have, and declines attribution for whatever fills the gap. An assistant calling this server may add commentary, comparison or recommendation of its own on top of the returned figures; that commentary is the assistant's and is outside what Muffed verifies or attributes.

Free, read-only, no account required. Fantasy scoring figures use half-PPR, the most common single redraft default, and say so wherever they appear.
payload.longDescription:
Muffed 使用经过核实的数据回答 NFL 问题。每个数字都来自基于 nflverse 逐回合数据、NFL Next Gen Stats 和 FTN 记录数据构建的受控面板；每个回答都会附上自己的来源、核实日期，以及数据许可要求的出处说明。

询问数据表明 NFL 当前真实情况如何，查询球员或球队的赛季数据，获取排行榜，用通俗语言了解 EPA 或 CPOE 等高级指标，并排比较两名球员，或核查你在其他地方看到的统计数据——如果数据不一致，Muffed 会告诉你真实数值。你还可以通过 id 连接 Sleeper 联赛，获取其中球员经核实的背景信息。

Muffed 不提供预测、首发／替补或阵容建议、选秀评分、作为建议的排名或推荐选项，也不提供投注盘口或赔率。此服务器上的任何工具都无法生成这些内容：它没有预测模型，也没有提供建议性排名的界面。

每个回答都会标明自身范围。引用会准确指出涵盖哪些数据，并声明其范围不包括从数据推导出的分析。按请求计算而非来自预先核实面板的数据，会标记为 `computed_not_verified`，并附上实际执行的方法和样本数量。如果 Muffed 没有用户请求的数据，会明确说明这一点、指出已有数据覆盖范围，并拒绝为填补空缺的内容提供出处归属。调用此服务器的助手可以在返回数据的基础上添加自己的评论、比较或建议；这些评论属于助手自身，并不在 Muffed 核实或注明来源的范围内。

免费、只读、无需账户。梦幻橄榄球得分使用 half-PPR，这是最常见的单一重选联盟默认规则；每当该规则出现时都会注明。

payload.name: Alation
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Alation brings trusted enterprise data context into ChatGPT.

Connect ChatGPT to Alation’s enterprise data catalog, governance, and trusted business context so users can discover, understand, and use data with confidence.

The Alation Intelligence Operating System (AIOS) helps AI ground responses in trusted enterprise context, including catalog metadata, governance policies, semantic definitions, lineage, data quality, and documentation. The app is designed for enterprise teams that need AI-led data discovery without losing trust, context, or governance.
payload.longDescription:
Alation将可信的企业数据上下文带入ChatGPT。

将ChatGPT连接到Alation的企业数据目录、治理体系和可信业务上下文，让用户能够放心地发现、理解和使用数据。

Alation Intelligence Operating System（AIOS）帮助AI以可信的企业上下文作为回答依据，包括目录元数据、治理政策、语义定义、数据血缘、数据质量和文档。该应用专为需要AI引导的数据发现，同时保持信任、上下文和治理的企业团队设计。

payload.name: WisdomAI
payload.description: 基于你治理的数据提供答案
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
WisdomAI is the enterprise data harness inside ChatGPT, for the complex analytical questions where the answer has to be deterministic, traceable, and consistent.

Connectors provide access. Catalogs and semantic layers provide definitions. The WisdomAI harness applies both at runtime by selecting the right context for each question, enforcing row- and column-level security for the person asking, optimizing execution for the underlying platform, verifying results, and repairing failed queries.

Business context strengthens continuously as WisdomAI learns from documents, query logs, catalogs, semantic layers, dbt, and BI metadata, proactively identifies where it lacked sufficient context, and routes proposed changes through expert review and versioning. Corrections become governed organizational knowledge rather than one-time fixes buried in individual conversations.

WisdomAI works across data platforms, sources, and deployment environments, including fully on-premises for regulated data that cannot leave your environment. The harness, the context, and query execution stay behind your firewall; only the answer crosses.

Every answer is grounded in governed definitions, enterprise data, and visible sources making it trustworthy enough to run your business on.

Use WisdomAI in ChatGPT to:
- Ask questions of governed business data: "How did Q3 net revenue track against plan in EMEA?"
- Follow up in the same line of analysis: "Break that down by segment and show the last 4 quarters"
- Investigate an open-ended question end to end: "We missed plan in EMEA last quarter. What drove it, which segments and accounts moved most, and what should we watch going into Q4?"
- Trace an answer to its definitions and sources: "Which definition of net revenue was used, and what data did it come from?"
- See what's available to you: "What data do I have access to, and which metrics are defined for finance?"
payload.longDescription:
WisdomAI 是 ChatGPT 内面向企业的数据处理框架，专为需要确定、可追溯且一致答案的复杂分析问题而设计。

连接器提供访问能力。目录和语义层提供定义。WisdomAI 框架在运行时结合二者，为每个问题选择合适上下文，执行针对提问者的行级和列级安全控制，针对底层平台优化执行，验证结果并修复失败的查询。

WisdomAI 会从文档、查询日志、目录、语义层、dbt 和 BI 元数据中持续学习，不断强化业务上下文，主动识别上下文不足之处，并将建议的更改提交专家审核和版本管理。修正内容会成为受治理的组织知识，而非埋没在个人对话中的一次性修补。

WisdomAI 适用于各种数据平台、数据源和部署环境，包括完全本地部署，以处理不得离开环境的受监管数据。框架、上下文和查询执行均保留在防火墙内；只有答案会传出。

每个答案都以受治理的定义、企业数据和可见来源为依据，可信到足以用于业务决策。

在 ChatGPT 中使用 WisdomAI 可以：
- 查询受治理的业务数据：“EMEA 第三季度净收入与计划相比如何？”
- 沿着同一分析继续追问：“按细分市场拆解，并显示最近 4 个季度的数据。”
- 端到端调查开放式问题：“上季度 EMEA 未达计划，是什么原因？哪些细分市场和客户变动最大？进入第四季度后应关注什么？”
- 追溯答案所依据的定义和来源：“使用了哪种净收入定义？数据来自哪里？”
- 查看自己可用的数据：“我可以访问哪些数据？财务有哪些已定义指标？”

payload.name: PowerDMARC
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PowerDMARC brings your email-authentication data into ChatGPT. Ask about any domain's security posture and get an interpreted DMARC, SPF, DKIM, BIMI, and MTA-STS breakdown. Dig into DMARC aggregate reports to see who's sending email as your domain, which sources are failing authentication, and where your mail is coming from by country and organization.

Look up live DNS and WHOIS records, generate correctly-formatted DMARC, SPF, and DKIM records, and review your hosted-service configuration.

Authentication is handled securely via OAuth — the plugin accesses only what your PowerDMARC account already permits, and never stores your credentials or tokens.
payload.longDescription:
PowerDMARC 可将电子邮件身份验证数据接入 ChatGPT。询问任意域名的安全状况，即可获取经过解读的 DMARC、SPF、DKIM、BIMI 和 MTA-STS 分析。深入查看 DMARC 汇总报告，了解哪些发件方正以你的域名发送邮件、哪些来源未通过身份验证，以及邮件分别来自哪些国家和组织。

查询实时 DNS 和 WHOIS 记录，生成格式正确的 DMARC、SPF 和 DKIM 记录，并检查托管服务配置。

身份验证通过 OAuth 安全处理——该插件只能访问你的 PowerDMARC 账户本已允许访问的内容，且绝不会存储你的凭据或令牌。

Designed for fleet, insurance, mobility, logistics, and driving-safety use cases, it provides secure access only to the Damoov companies and data available to the authenticated user.

Connect your ARIA account and start asking.
payload.longDescription:
ARIA 是 ChatGPT 中的消费者洞察分析师。就你的品类提出问题，例如高蛋白零食、肠道健康、护肤，或任何客户关心的话题，ARIA 就会查阅数百万条真实社交对话，依据实际帖子和视频作答。
无需等待数周获取研究演示文稿，直接在聊天中得到答案：哪些趋势正在兴起、原因是什么，你的品牌相较品类领导者给人怎样的印象，哪些宣传主张和吸引点能引发共鸣，以及受众实际上在寻求什么。每条洞察都有背后的真实对话支撑，让你能够信赖并据此行动。
使用 ARIA 及早发现新趋势、验证产品和营销活动创意、了解品牌情绪倾向，并找到客户已经在使用的语言。专为品牌、营销、洞察和产品团队打造，让团队无需进行任何问卷调查就能与市场对话。
连接 ARIA 账号，开始提问。

payload.name: Logimu Shopping
payload.description: 查找 Amazon 和 Walmart 商品
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Look up real product data from Amazon and Walmart while you chat.

Ask an open-ended question ("a quiet burr grinder under $150") and get a
ranked shortlist with current prices, ratings and stock. Ask about a
specific product and get its price, stock status, rating, review count
and how many sellers are competing on it — plus how price and
availability moved over the last 30 days.

Data comes from a continuously refreshed warehouse of 17M+ tracked
products across Amazon US, UK, Germany, Canada and Australia, and
Walmart US. Every record carries the timestamp it was observed, so you
can tell how fresh it is. Ranking is based on the product data itself —
no affiliate links, sponsored placements or paid seller positions.

Works with no signup.
payload.longDescription:
在聊天时查询 Amazon 和 Walmart 的真实商品数据。

提出开放式问题（“$150 以下、声音安静的锥刀磨豆机”），即可获得按排名排列的候选清单，包括当前价格、评分和库存。询问具体商品，可获得价格、库存状态、评分、评论数、参与竞争的卖家数量，以及过去 30 天价格和可用性的变化。

数据来自持续刷新的仓库，覆盖 Amazon 美国、英国、德国、加拿大和澳大利亚站点，以及 Walmart 美国站的 17M+ 件受追踪商品。每条记录都带有观测时间戳，方便判断新鲜度。排名基于商品数据本身——不含联盟链接、赞助展示或付费卖家位置。

无需注册即可使用。

payload.name: Impala
payload.description: 非营利组织和基金会数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Smarter data, greater impact, right inside your AI workflow. Impala's connector gives you instant organization and funder intel on any U.S. nonprofit or foundation, drawn live from a database of 2M+ nonprofits, 250K+ grantmakers, and 25M+ grants built from verified registries, government databases, and direct partnerships.

Built for the teams that power philanthropy: grants management, programs, development, funder networks, and advisors. Ask it to:

- Research any nonprofit or foundation: mission, programs, leadership, board, and how to apply
- Check financial health with Form 990 income statements, balance sheets, key ratios, and multi-year trends
- Verify an organization's 501(c)(3) tax-exempt standing
- Map who funds whom: a nonprofit's institutional funders, a foundation's grantees, and grant histories
- Understand a funder's giving profile by cause area and geography, or spot funder overlap across organizations
- Discover new nonprofits and funders by cause, geography, type, and size

Every answer is source-attributed and links back to the full record on Impala so you can verify the underlying data. All tools are read-only. Connecting creates a free Impala account; some tools may require a premium Impala subscription.
payload.longDescription:
Impala 的连接器提供美国非营利组织和基金会的机构及资助方信息，实时来自包含 200 万多个非营利组织、25 万个资助方和

2,500 万笔资助的数据库。可研究使命、项目、领导层、董事会和申请方式；用

Form 990 检查财务健康；核验 501(c)(3) 免税资格；绘制资助关系和历史；按事业领域和地理位置了解资助方画像；按事业、地域、类型和规模发现组织。每个回答带来源并链接到 Impala

完整记录。工具只读；连接会创建免费 Impala 账户，部分工具可能需要高级订阅。

payload.name: Collecte MTL
payload.description: 查询蒙特利尔垃圾收集日
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Collecte MTL tells you when your waste is collected anywhere on the island of Montréal. Enter an address and get the pickup schedule for every stream — garbage, recycling, food and organic waste, green waste, and bulky items — including the next upcoming collection dates for that exact sector.

It can also point you to the nearest écocentres (drop-off centres) for materials that aren't picked up curbside, and show your borough's waste recovery and diversion rates.

The data comes straight from the City of Montréal's official open data (Secteurs Info-collectes), refreshed about once a month. Collecte MTL is a free, independent tool — not affiliated with the City of Montréal — and stores no personal information: an address is used only to look up its collection sector.
payload.longDescription:
Collecte MTL 会告诉你蒙特利尔岛上任何地点的垃圾收集时间。输入地址，即可获取各种类别的收集安排——垃圾、回收物、厨余和有机垃圾、绿色垃圾以及大件物品——包括该具体片区下一次收集日期。

它还可以指引你前往最近的 écocentres（投放中心），处理不提供路边收集的材料，并显示你所在行政区的废弃物回收和分流率。

数据直接来自蒙特利尔市官方开放数据（Secteurs Info-collectes），大约每月更新一次。Collecte MTL 是免费的独立工具，与蒙特利尔市无隶属关系，也不存储个人信息：地址仅用于查询所属收集片区。

payload.name: Looki
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your Looki memories into Codex for personalized answers grounded in your real-world context. Browse moments by date, search memories by meaning, open a specific moment and its media, revisit AI-generated highlights, or check the latest realtime event when available. Temporary media links are treated as private, short-lived data.
payload.longDescription: 将 Looki 中的记忆带入 Codex，让个性化回答以你的真实生活背景为依据。你可以按日期浏览片段、按含义搜索记忆、打开特定片段及其媒体、重温 AI 生成的精彩集锦，或在有数据时查看最新实时事件。临时媒体链接会按私人且短期有效的数据处理。

payload.name: Feedoptimise
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Manage your product feeds directly from ChatGPT. Connect your account to inspect sources, feeds, products, attribute mappings, and revision history without opening the platform.

Run feed audits to catch data quality issues before they reach channels like Google Shopping, Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Microsoft Shopping, TikTok, Pinterest, and ChatGPT Ads, plus more than 3,500 others.

Review Google Merchant Center diagnostics, search for and block individual items, and force a sync when you need changes live immediately. You can also get step-by-step guidance on feed setup, optimization, and A/B testing, from mapping attributes and improving product titles to running experiments on any feed attribute and letting performance data pick the winner.

Built for merchants, agencies, and digital marketing specialists who want to check, fix, and optimize their shopping feeds as part of a conversation.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 管理商品信息流：检查来源、产品、属性映射和修订历史，审计质量问题，查看。3。500

Merchant Center 诊断、阻止商品、强制同步，并获取设置、优化和。3。500

payload.name: MyGeotab MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Monitor vehicles, analyze trips and driver behavior, and stay on top of safety exceptions, diagnostics, maintenance, EV charging, and compliance across your fleet in MyGeotab. Bring that live data into ChatGPT — then act on it: set up zones and rules, acknowledge faults, and generate reports without leaving the conversation. Surface speeding and utilization trends, answer fleet questions in plain language, and turn insight into action as part of your AI workflow.
payload.longDescription: 在 MyGeotab 中监控车辆、分析行程和驾驶员行为，并掌握车队的安全异常、诊断、维护、电动车充电和合规情况。将实时数据接入 ChatGPT 后即可采取行动：设置区域和规则、确认故障并生成报告，全程无需离开对话。了解超速和利用率趋势，用日常语言询问车队情况，并将洞察融入 AI 工作流程，转化为实际行动。

payload.name: Kanal
payload.description: 你的 WhatsApp 营销数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kanal is a WhatsApp marketing platform for e-commerce brands.
Connect your Kanal account to ask ChatGPT anything about your WhatsApp marketing performance: attributed revenue, ROAS and total channel cost, campaign and automation stats down to individual flow steps, audience segments and sizes, and Meta template approval status. 

All tools are read-only, and every metric uses the same attribution engine and settings as your Kanal dashboard, so the numbers always match what you see in the app. 

Example questions: 
- "What's my WhatsApp ROAS over the last 30 days?"
- "Compare my last 3 campaigns"
- "Which step of my abandoned-cart flow converts best?". 

Requires a Kanal account (Scale plan for full access, discovery quota on Pro).
payload.longDescription:
Kanal 是面向电商品牌的 WhatsApp 营销平台。
连接你的 Kanal 账户后，可以向 ChatGPT 询问 WhatsApp 营销表现的任何信息：归因收入、ROAS 和渠道总成本、营销活动与自动化数据（细化到单个流程步骤）、受众细分及规模，以及 Meta 模板的审批状态。

所有工具均为只读；每项指标都使用与你的 Kanal 控制面板相同的归因引擎和设置，因此数字始终与你在应用中看到的一致。

示例问题：
- “过去 30 天我的 WhatsApp ROAS 是多少？”
- “比较我最近 3 个营销活动”
- “我的弃购流程中哪一步的转化效果最好？”

需要 Kanal 账户（Scale 方案可完整访问，Pro 方案提供探索配额）。

payload.name: Infoparcelle
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Query official French land and property data in plain language: 94 million cadastral
parcels, actual recorded sale prices (DVF), energy performance certificates, zoning
and planning rules, building permits, corporate owners, condominiums and businesses
registered at an address.

14 tools let you geocode an address, open a full parcel record, compare actual sale
prices in a neighbourhood, or filter properties by energy rating. Data comes from
official public sources (DGFiP, Cerema, ADEME, INSEE, IGN, SDES) and is reported as
published, without reinterpretation.

Covers mainland France and the five overseas departments. Requires an Infoparcelle
account whose plan includes API credits. Each search consumes 1 to 20 credits
depending on the dataset.
payload.longDescription:
